instruction.text: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

atoms.b: An obtuse angle is an angle that is ((++larger smaller)) than a right angle.

instruction.text: Drag the triangles into the correct places in the Carroll diagram.

hint.label: Carroll diagram
hint.text:
The triangle with a right angle and no obtuse angles goes in the top right box.

The triangle with no right angles and an obtuse angle goes in the bottom left box.

The triangle with no right angles and no obtuse angles goes in the bottom right box.

instruction.text: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

atoms.b: An acute angle is an angle that is ((larger ++smaller)) than a right angle.

instruction.text: Drag the triangles into the correct places in the Carroll diagram.

hint.label: Carroll diagram
hint.text:
The triangle with at least two equal sides and two acute angles goes in the bottom left box.

The triangle with no equal sides and two acute angles goes in the bottom right box.

The triangle with at least two equal sides and three acute angles goes in the top left box.
